column1: # High-frequency Bangla words for Amader Bangla Keyboard.  Format: bangla<TAB>weight
# Hand-curated everyday vocabulary (chat, social media, news). Layered over the big
# lexicon in words.tsv (which has no real frequency data): a word listed here keeps
# the higher weight, so common words outrank rare ones of the same length.
# Tiers: 90 = core function words · 70 = very common · 50 = common · 35 = frequent.
